def maxCandies(status, candies, keys, containedBoxes, initialBoxes):
    open_boxes = set()
    available_keys = set()
    available_boxes = set(initialBoxes)
    total_candies = 0

    while available_boxes:
        current_box = available_boxes.pop()
        if status[current_box] == 1:
            total_candies += candies[current_box]
            open_boxes.add(current_box)
            available_keys.update(keys[current_box])
            available_boxes.update(containedBoxes[current_box])
        else:
            available_boxes.add(current_box)

        # Remove boxes that have been opened from available_boxes
        available_boxes -= open_boxes

    return total_candies
